blocks.text: This User Agreement (“Agreement”) governs access to and use of the BeeBark website, mobile application, software, platform and related services (collectively, the “Platform”) provided by BEEBARK TECH LLP, a company incorporated under the laws of India, having its registered office at 249, First Floor, Kandle Kashan Fatehpuri, Chandni Chowk, Chandni Chowk Police Station, Delhi, North Delhi – 110006, India.

By accessing, registering for, or using the Platform, you (“User”, “you” or “your”) agree to be legally bound by this Agreement, the BeeBark Privacy Policy and any other policies expressly incorporated into this Agreement.
If you do not agree to this Agreement, you must not access or use the Platform.

body.text: BeeBark is a specialised professional digital platform for persons and organisations operating in or connected with the built environment, including architecture, interior design, construction, real estate and related professional disciplines. The Platform may provide, among other things:

items: AI-assisted portfolio creation and content organisation;
other features introduced by BeeBark from time to time.

body.text: The Platform is intended to facilitate professional presentation, discovery and interaction. BeeBark does not itself become a party to any professional, employment, consultancy, contractor, collaboration or other transaction between Users merely because the Platform facilitates that interaction.

An employer, recruiter, business or other User is solely responsible for its dealings with candidates or other Users. Similarly, a candidate or professional is solely responsible for representations made to employers, businesses or other Users.
This Agreement constitutes an electronic contract between you and BeeBark and does not require physical or handwritten execution.

By clicking “I Agree”, “Sign Up”, “Create Account”, “Continue”, or any substantially similar mechanism, or by otherwise accessing or using the Platform after being provided access to this Agreement, you signify your acceptance of this Agreement.
You represent that you have the legal capacity to enter into this Agreement under applicable Indian law.

Where you use the Platform on behalf of a company, partnership, LLP, firm, trust, institution or other organisation (“Business”), you represent and warrant that you have authority to bind that Business.
Electronic records generated in connection with your use of the Platform may constitute evidence of your acceptance and transactions, subject to applicable law.
You may use the Platform only if:

items: you satisfy the minimum age requirement specified by BeeBark i.e. 18+ years;
you are legally capable of entering into a binding contract;
your use of the Platform is lawful in the jurisdiction applicable to you; and
you are not prohibited from using the Platform under applicable law.

body.text: You must not create or operate an account for another person without lawful authority.

items: submit false credentials or professional claims;

engage in unlawful discrimination, harassment, threats or abuse;
introduce malware, ransomware, viruses, malicious code or harmful software;

use the Platform to infringe another person’s rights;

Users may request closure or deletion of their portfolio through the mechanism made available by BeeBark. When the user requests to delete content or their portfolio, the deletion process shall automatically begin no more than 30 days after such request. It may take up to 90 days to delete content after the deletion process begins.

BeeBark shall process deletion requests in accordance with applicable law and its Privacy Policy. While the deletion process is being undertaken, the content/ portfolio remains subject to this Agreement and Privacy Policy.

After the content is deleted, it may take up to another 90 days to delete it from Beebark’s backups and disaster recovery systems. Certain information may be retained where required or permitted by law, including for:

items: legitimate operational purposes permitted by law.
